originalTitle: PM praises Sally McManus and Michele O’Neil as ‘giants’ as they resign from ACTU
summary: Secretary and president of Australian Council of Trade Unions announced surprise departures on Monday evening
content: The leadership of the trade union movement is set for a major shakeup after the secretary and president of the Australian Council of Trade Unions announced their surprise departures. The ACTU’s secretary, Sally McManus, and its president, Michele O’Neil, revealed on Monday night they would be stepping down after eight years together. Anthony Albanese described both as personal friends and “giants of the labour movement”. The first all-female leadership team in the ACTU’s 99-year history, the influential pair played a major role in shaping the Albanese government’s workplace agenda. Sign up for the Breaking News Australia email They successfully campaigned for the right to disconnect law, same job, same pay protections, wage theft criminalisation and ensuring minimum pay, insurance and safety standards for gig economy workers. The ACTU recently began targeting Pauline Hanson, in a clear sign the union movement now considers One Nation – rather than the Coalition – the biggest political threat to Labor and economic risk for working people. McManus will depart in August while O’Neil will help the new secretary settle in before leaving before the end of the year. In a farewell video posted to social media on Monday night, the pair said it was time for renewal. “Union membership is growing and workers have over 47 new workplace rights,” McManus said. “But, of course, there are still big challenges with cost-of-living pressures, AI and billionaires who have too much wealth and power.” In a statement, the prime minister said McManus and O’Neil’s “tireless advocacy and strong leadership” had put working families “in a stronger financial position today than they would otherwise be”. “It is fitting that Sally and Michele announce they’re stepping down from their respective positions at a time when there have been significant wage increases in critical and long-undervalued sectors, the gender pay gap is at a record low and union membership is growing for the first time in decades,” Albanese said. Speaking on ABC radio on Tuesday morning, O’Neil said the pair were “very trusting of each other”, and that the union was in good shape. O’Neil ruled out seeking a career as a politician but would not reveal what her next move would be. “I want to take a moment to breathe. I know more about what I won’t do than what I will do, but that’s OK,” she said. “I’m very happy to take some time to think about it.” The Greens’ leader, Larissa Waters, described them as a “powerful duo” and “strong voices for workers”. “The union movement is strongest when it is bold, independent and willing to put workers’ rights ahead of vested interests. Sally and Michele have embodied that spirit in their leadership pushing the Albanese Labor government to implement a minimum 25% tax on gas exports and for action to address the housing crisis,” she said. “We are entering what could be the most challenging period for Australian workers in recent history. “It will be the task of the ACTU’s new leadership to hold governments to account, demand a good living for workers and refuse to allow political parties to tinker and capitulate to vested interests.”
chineseTitle: 萨莉·麦克马纳斯 (Sally McManus) 和米歇尔·奥尼尔 (Michele O’Neil) 从 ACTU 辞职后，总理称赞他们是“巨人”
chineseSummary: 澳大利亚工会理事会秘书和主席周一晚间宣布意外离职
chineseContent: 在澳大利亚工会理事会秘书和主席宣布意外离职后，工会运动的领导层将进行重大改组。 ACTU 秘书莎莉·麦克马纳斯 (Sally McManus) 及其主席米歇尔·奥尼尔 (Michele O’Neil) 周一晚上透露，他们将在合作八年后辞职。安东尼·阿尔巴内斯将两人描述为私人朋友和“劳工运动的巨人”。这是 ACTU 99 年历史上第一个全女性领导团队，这对颇具影响力的夫妇在制定阿尔巴尼亚政府的工作场所议程方面发挥了重要作用。他们成功地争取了脱离法律的权利、相同的工作、相同的工资保护、工资盗窃刑事定罪以及确保零工经济工人的最低工资、保险和安全标准。 ACTU 最近开始针对 Pauline Hanson，这是工会运动现在认为一国党（而不是联盟党）对工党最大的政治威胁和劳动人民的经济风险的明显迹象。麦克马纳斯将于八月离职，而奥尼尔将帮助新秘书安顿下来，然后在年底前离职。在周一晚上发布到社交媒体上的告别视频中，两人表示是时候续约了。 “工会成员数量不断增加，工人拥有超过 47 项新的工作场所权利，”麦克马纳斯说。 “但是，当然，生活成本压力、人工智能以及拥有过多财富和权力的亿万富翁仍然面临着巨大的挑战。”总理在一份声明中表示，麦克马纳斯和奥尼尔的“不懈倡导和强有力的领导”使工薪家庭“如今的财务状况比平时更强大”。 “莎莉和米歇尔宣布他们辞去各自的职务是恰当的。
